<div class="wv-epigraph">{{spoiler|book=tg-01-house-of-blades|“Give me your power, Eldest,” Simon said. “I accept your deal.”}}<div class="wv-epigraph-cite">{{spoiler|book=tg-01-house-of-blades|— ''House of Blades'', chapter 9}}</div></div>
''See also: [[Simon Timeline]]''

== Overview ==
{{spoiler|book=tg-03-city-of-light|Simon, the son of [[Kalman]], is a tall and physically powerful young man characterized by his dark gold hair and a confident presence. Growing up in a village, he was known for being helpful and well-liked by his peers. He is driven by a deep, resolute commitment to ensure his mother's survival, a motivation rooted in his past struggles and his sense of duty to his father. While he lacks an interest in seeking political power or [[Authority|authority]], he has become a [[Traveler]] of [[Valinhall]] and is identified as the [[Lirial Traveler]]. His life involves complex connections to [[Damascan]] figures, including an Overlord and a territory advisor, and he has been tasked by the [[Eldest]] to perform work in the outside world.}}

== Appearance ==
{{spoiler|book=tg-03-city-of-light|Simon is a skinny young man who wears a black cloak and a half-silver, half-black [[The mask|mask]]. Through this [[The mask|mask]], his eyes appear as a dim, sourceless light or flare white and transparent. He also possesses black, chain-like marks on his skin that move and crawl up his arms, shoulders, ribs, and neck.}}

== Personality ==
{{spoiler|book=tg-03-city-of-light|Simon prefers to work quietly and by himself. He is motivated by a desire to rescue people taken from his village and has served as a protector for his mother. He is also known to be a person who has bargained with the [[Eldest]] and accepted the role of [[Queen Leah I|Queen Leah]]'s personal protector.}}

== Relationships ==
{{spoiler|book=tg-03-city-of-light|Simon is the son of [[Kalman]] and was raised around [[Nurita]]'s family. He has served as the personal protector for [[Queen Leah I|Queen Leah]], whom he has worked with to seal an [[Incarnation]]. Simon is a student or subordinate of [[Kai]] and has been trained by [[Indirial]], though he also studied under [[Valin]]. He is currently traveling with [[Denner Weeks|Denner]] and has provided orders to [[Andra Agnos|Andra]]. [[Simon's mother]] was killed by [[Cormac]], and he once fought against the [[Malachi|Overlord Malachi]]. Additionally, Simon has a connection to the doll [[Rebekkah]] and has previously killed soldiers under [[Erastes]]' command.}}

== Abilities ==
{{spoiler|book=tg-03-city-of-light|Simon can draw on [[Nye essence]] and [[Valinhall]] [[steel]] to increase his reflexes, slow his perception of time, and bolster his physical strength. He is able to summon weapons such as the sword Azura, the sword [[Mithra]], and a massive hammer made of mirror-bright [[Tartarus steel]]. Additionally, he can open [[Gates]] and has the power to bind himself to [[Valinhall]].}}

== History ==
=== {{spoiler|book=tg-01-house-of-blades|Life in the village}} ===
{{spoiler|book=tg-01-house-of-blades|Simon is a skinny eight-year-old boy and the son of [[Kalman]].<ref name="tg-01-house-of-blades-c1">''House of Blades'', chapter 1</ref><ref name="tg-01-house-of-blades-c3">''House of Blades'', chapter 3</ref> A boy who has cared for his mother since childhood, he prefers to work alone and keeps a sword hidden beneath a dusty rug in his home.<ref name="tg-01-house-of-blades-c2">''House of Blades'', chapter 2</ref> After attempting to attack [[Cormac]]'s legs with his sword, Simon found himself in a cave where his mother lay unconscious before she passed away.<ref name="tg-01-house-of-blades-c4">''House of Blades'', chapter 4</ref> Though he is not a [[Traveler]], Simon was held at dagger-point by a man in the forest while suffering from wounded hands.<ref name="tg-01-house-of-blades-c4" /><ref name="tg-01-house-of-blades-c5">''House of Blades'', chapter 5</ref> Believing the forest [[Demon]] had spared him once before, he sought help to retrieve villagers taken by [[Malachi|Overlord Malachi]] after witnessing a white-haired man kill [[Travelers]].<ref name="tg-01-house-of-blades-c5" /> An amateur swordsman who has spent his time cleaning a tavern and delivering messages, Simon claimed to have no talent and had not eaten for over three days.<ref name="tg-01-house-of-blades-c6">''House of Blades'', chapter 6</ref> While living in a village, he fought three [[iron armors]] before being defeated, holding forward the shattered remnants of a secondhand weapon purchased from a desperate merchant's guard.<ref name="tg-01-house-of-blades-c7">''House of Blades'', chapter 7</ref>}}

{{spoiler|book=tg-01-house-of-blades|By the time of his arrival in [[Valinhall]], Simon had already been present in the realm for at least a month.<ref name="tg-01-house-of-blades-c8">''House of Blades'', chapter 8</ref> He carries a single-edged sword that possesses a curve similar to Azura's, though it is less than half the length of that weapon.<ref name="tg-01-house-of-blades-c8" /> During his time there, Simon accepted the deal offered by the [[Eldest]].<ref name="tg-01-house-of-blades-c9">''House of Blades'', chapter 9</ref>}}

=== {{spoiler|book=tg-01-house-of-blades|Trial in Orgrith Cave}} ===
{{spoiler|book=tg-01-house-of-blades|While traveling on foot with [[Denner Weeks|Denner]] toward [[Orgrith Cave]], Simon prepares to undergo a trial as a student.<ref name="tg-01-house-of-blades-c11">''House of Blades'', chapter 11</ref> Utilizing [[Benson's steel]] and the [[Nye essence]], he fights a monster within the cave and finds himself unable to leave for six nights.<ref name="tg-01-house-of-blades-c11" /> After consuming a draught of [[steel]] strength, he is able to push aside a giant mushroom cap with a single hand.<ref name="tg-01-house-of-blades-c12">''House of Blades'', chapter 12</ref> Driven by the motivation to rescue [[Andra Agnos|Andra]], the young man possesses enhanced reflexes and moving, chain-like marks on his arms.<ref name="tg-01-house-of-blades-c12" /><ref name="tg-01-house-of-blades-c13">''House of Blades'', chapter 13</ref> Though he has been a [[Traveler]] for only a few weeks, Simon can call [[liquid steel]] from [[Valinhall]].<ref name="tg-01-house-of-blades-c13" /><ref name="tg-01-house-of-blades-c14">''House of Blades'', chapter 14</ref> By drawing on the [[Nye essence]] to increase his perception of time and reflexes, he can call [[steel]] to join with the cool [[breath of the Nye]].<ref name="tg-01-house-of-blades-c14" /> This process allows him to create chain-shaped shadows on his skin using [[liquid steel]].<ref name="tg-01-house-of-blades-c14" /> When an arrow is shot toward him, Simon uses [[Nye]]'s breath to gain cool power and bolsters his strength with [[Benson's steel]].<ref name="tg-01-house-of-blades-c14" /><ref name="tg-01-house-of-blades-c15">''House of Blades'', chapter 15</ref> As his arms become chain-shrouded through the use of his [[steel]], he demonstrates the ability to call [[steel]] and summon Azura before sending a message to [[Caela]] to thank her for her warning.<ref name="tg-01-house-of-blades-c15" />}}

=== {{spoiler|book=tg-01-house-of-blades|Traveler in Valinhall}} ===
{{spoiler|book=tg-01-house-of-blades|While traveling in a rumbling wagon bed, Simon, a [[Traveler]] from the [[Valinhall]] [[Territory]], recalls growing up alongside [[Nurita]]'s family.<ref name="tg-01-house-of-blades-c17">''House of Blades'', chapter 17</ref> He possesses an interest in speaking with [[the Nye]] and utilizes their speed alongside the strength of [[steel]].<ref name="tg-01-house-of-blades-c18">''House of Blades'', chapter 18</ref> Although his [[shadow-chains]] have not yet reached his hands, he uses [[Nye essence]] to slow time.<ref name="tg-01-house-of-blades-c18" /> Clad in a black cloak, he is able to summon the sword Azura.<ref name="tg-01-house-of-blades-c19">''House of Blades'', chapter 19</ref> Simon possesses [[Nye essence]] and [[liquid strength]], utilizing both [[steel]] and essence to increase his speed.<ref name="tg-01-house-of-blades-c21">''House of Blades'', chapter 21</ref> His gifts are evident in the [[black chains]] on his forearms that resemble living tattoos.<ref name="tg-01-house-of-blades-c21" /> As the only member of his group capable of opening a Gate to escape, he is later suspected to have died in a canyon between [[Bel Calem]] and [[Enosh]].<ref name="tg-01-house-of-blades-c22">''House of Blades'', chapter 22</ref><ref name="tg-01-house-of-blades-c23">''House of Blades'', chapter 23</ref> Before becoming a [[Traveler]], he lived in [[Myria]] and suffered the loss of his parents, whose deaths were caused by [[Travelers]] from [[Enosh]].<ref name="tg-01-house-of-blades-c23" />}}

=== {{spoiler|book=tg-02-crimson-vault|Life in Enosh}} ===

=== {{spoiler|book=tg-03-city-of-light|Presence in Cana}} ===
{{spoiler|book=tg-03-city-of-light|After rising from the walls of [[Cana]], Simon struggled to move his body following his use of [[The mask|the mask]].<ref name="tg-03-city-of-light-c23">''City of Light'', chapter 23</ref><ref name="tg-03-city-of-light-c24">''City of Light'', chapter 24</ref> A man who has previously bargained with the [[Eldest]], he sat in a [[graveyard]] while holding the sword [[Mithra]].<ref name="tg-03-city-of-light-c24" /><ref name="tg-03-city-of-light-c25">''City of Light'', chapter 25</ref> Using his powers, Simon bound himself to [[Valinhall]], a process involving his ability to draw on power within another [[Territory]].<ref name="tg-03-city-of-light-c25" /> Though he possesses between five and seven [[Incarnations]], Simon struck [[Grandmaster Naraka]] with a giant hammer, causing ash to spray out instead of blood.<ref name="tg-03-city-of-light-c25" /><ref name="tg-03-city-of-light-c26">''City of Light'', chapter 26</ref> He reported that the King is moving against [[Elysia]] after an attempt to destroy [[Valinhall]], noting that his sword features a gold line down the middle that sings to [[Alin]].<ref name="tg-03-city-of-light-c26" /> While giving orders to [[Andra Agnos|Andra]], Simon utilized a gold-and-silver blade.<ref name="tg-03-city-of-light-c27">''City of Light'', chapter 27</ref> Having proven his valor, Simon can be empowered by the [[White Light]] with the might of [[Elysia]].<ref name="tg-03-city-of-light-c27" />}}

=== {{spoiler|book=tg-03-city-of-light|Protector of Leah}} ===
{{spoiler|book=tg-03-city-of-light|Simon has accepted the role of personal protector to [[Queen Leah I|Queen Leah]].<ref name="tg-03-city-of-light-c28">''City of Light'', chapter 28</ref> As the [[Founder]] of [[Valinhall]], he also serves as the custodian of the [[Incarnations]] and holds the position of royal protector.<ref name="tg-03-city-of-light-c28" />}}

== Notable quotes ==
* {{spoiler|book=tg-01-house-of-blades|“Give me your power, Eldest,” Simon said. “I accept your deal.”<ref name="tg-01-house-of-blades-c9" />}}
* {{spoiler|book=tg-01-house-of-blades|“Then you came! That monster was nothing for you.”<ref name="tg-01-house-of-blades-c11" />}}
* {{spoiler|book=tg-01-house-of-blades|“I can’t leave the cave for six nights after this one.<ref name="tg-01-house-of-blades-c11" />}}
* {{spoiler|book=tg-02-crimson-vault|A young, black-cloaked man with a long sword. Even underneath the mask… “Simon?” Alin muttered<ref name="tg-02-crimson-vault-c21" />}}
* {{spoiler|book=tg-03-city-of-light|“It would spill everywhere,” Simon said, feeling like an idiot for answering such an obvious question.<ref name="tg-03-city-of-light-c8" />}}
